title: Coolie No. 1
desc: A matchmaker sets out to teach Hoshiyar Chand a lesson while hilarity ensues when he asks Raju, a coolie, to pretend to be a millionaire.

title: Saajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder presumes that his first wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he learns that Pooja is alive, he has to juggle between his wives, keeping both his marriages a secret.

title: Jaan
desc: A top cop hires a man to guard his grandchild, unaware of the lurking threat. However, this protector is a hitman sent by kin to bump off the successor and grab the hefty estate.

title: Himmatwar
desc: The son of a wealthy man leaves his family post a misunderstanding. Later, when he saves a police officer from an evil man, this results in him earning the latter's wrath.

title: Indian
desc: Police officer Raj Azad arrests terrorist Wasim Khan and prepares to interrogate him. However, his father-in-law mysteriously dies, after which he is blamed for his death and goes on the run.
